picks.name: 100% Merino Crew Neck Jumper, navy
picks.why: Your office and date-night outfits still have no knit. This is a plain regular-fit crew in fine-gauge merino, so it stays neat at the waist rather than adding bulk, and it's warm enough for the colder months. Wear it over a tee with the fawn chinos and brown Docs, or with the 502s for a date.

picks.name: AIRism Cotton Crew Neck T-Shirt, olive
picks.why: A plain tee is the base layer for three of your five outfits and you still have none on the list. Regular fit, standard length, no branding, and smooth enough to sit cleanly under knits and the Ashby. Olive works tonally with the Ashby, or under the navy raglan sweat with the 502s and Sambas.

picks.name: 3001 Overshirt, army green
picks.why: Down to £59.50 from £85, which is your target price. A heavy cotton chore-style overshirt with a regular body and patch pockets, no logo, made for layering over a tee or thin knit through autumn. Wear it open over a tee with the navy relaxed chinos and Vans Era, or under the navy Parachute jacket on photography walks.
